business_meaning: Unique identifier for the savings account.
inferred_rules: Must be unique within table; not null; primary business identifier for account-level lookups.

business_meaning: Identifier of the customer who owns the account.
inferred_rules: Foreign-key relationship to customer dimension expected; not null for active accounts.

business_meaning: Code for the savings product type or product offering.
inferred_rules: Should map to a product master list; not null.

business_meaning: Current operational status of the account.
inferred_rules: Typical statuses include active/closed/dormant; if status = 'CLOSED' then AccountCloseDate should not be null; status changes are time-ordered.

business_meaning: Currency code in which the account is denominated.
inferred_rules: Expected to be ISO 4217 three-letter code; not null.
Must be on or before AccountCloseDate (if present) and on or before AccountMaturityDate (if present); should not be a future date.

business_meaning: Maturity date for time-bound savings products (if applicable).
inferred_rules: If present, should be on or after AccountOpenDate; may be null for non-term products.

business_meaning: Date the account was closed (if closed).
inferred_rules: If not null, must be on or after AccountOpenDate; if AccountStatus = 'CLOSED' then expected to be not null; should not be a future date.

business_meaning: Interest rate applied to the account (annual).
inferred_rules: Should be non-negative; may be zero for non-interest-bearing products; units expected to be percent (e.g., 1.25 for 1.25%).

business_meaning: Current monetary balance of the account.
inferred_rules: Numeric scale consistent with currency; should normally be >= 0 unless product allows overdraft; must be zero or reconciled when account is closed.

business_meaning: Start of the validity period for this record/version.
inferred_rules: Used for temporal versioning; should be <= ValidTo when ValidTo is populated; current record likely has ValidTo = NULL or a max value.

business_meaning: End of the validity period for this record/version.
inferred_rules: Used for temporal versioning; null or a high-date for the current record; should be >= ValidFrom when populated.

business_meaning: Timestamp when this row was loaded into the curate table.
inferred_rules: Populated at load time; used for audit and ETL reconciliation; should be <= current system time at load.
